SELECT count(trade_amount) AS totalConsumerCount, ROUND(ABS(SUM(trade_amount)), 2) AS totalRevenue FROM bbx_restaurant_card_record WHERE trade_amount IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ABS(trade_amount)), 0), 2) AS totalTradeAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(account_balance), 0), 2) AS totalAccountBalance, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN card_no IS NOT NULL THEN card_no END) AS distinctCardCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN card_no IS NOT NULL AND trade_amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS totalConsumeCount FROM bbx_restaurant_card_record WHERE deleted = 1
and tenant_id =#{tenantId}
